Spanish presentation: Introdujiste una contraseña

Spanish presentation: Esto requiere actuar pronto:

English key: Change it anywhere else you used the same password
Spanish presentation: Cámbiala también en las otras cuentas donde la usaste

English key: Turn on two-factor authentication (2FA) if available
Spanish presentation: Activar la autenticación de dos factores (2FA), si está disponible

English key: Situation C: You Entered a Debit or Credit Card Number
Spanish presentation: Introdujiste el número de una tarjeta

English key: You should:
Spanish presentation: Sigue estos pasos:

English key: Contact your bank or credit card company immediately

English key: Explain what happened
Spanish presentation: Explica lo ocurrido

English key: Ask if they recommend freezing or replacing your card
Spanish presentation: Pregunta si conviene bloquear o reemplazar la tarjeta

English key: Watch your account for unfamiliar charges
Spanish presentation: Revisa tu cuenta para detectar cargos desconocidos

English key: Situation D: You Entered Your Social Security Number or Other Sensitive Information

English key: Imagine you check your bank account and see a coffee shop charge for $4.50 that you didn't make. Then you notice an electronics store charge for $689.99 that you definitely didn't make. This is called an unauthorized transaction - a purchase or withdrawal you didn't approve.
Spanish presentation: Al revisar tu cuenta, ves un cargo de $4.50 en una cafetería que no hiciste. Después encuentras otro de $689.99 en una tienda de electrónica que tampoco reconoces. Son posibles operaciones no autorizadas: compras o retiros que no aprobaste.

English key: The faster you act, the easier it is for your bank to help protect your money. Don't wait to "see if it fixes itself."
Spanish presentation: Cuanto antes avises, antes podrá el banco ayudarte a proteger tu dinero. No esperes a que se solucione solo.

Spanish presentation: Qué cargo no reconoces

English key: When you noticed it

English key: Whether your card is still in your possession

English key: The bank may lock your card, issue a replacement card, investigate the charges, or help recover your money if possible.
Spanish presentation: El banco puede bloquear la tarjeta, reemplazarla, investigar los cargos o intentar recuperar el dinero.

English key: What Is a Credit Freeze?
Spanish presentation: ¿Qué es un congelamiento de crédito?

English key: Imagine someone steals your personal information, like your Social Security number, and tries to open a new credit card or loan in your name. A credit freeze helps stop this. A credit freeze prevents most lenders from viewing your credit report - if they can't view your credit, they usually won't approve a new credit card or loan. Think of it like putting a lock on your credit file. Even if someone has your information, a freeze makes it much harder for them to open new accounts in your name.
Spanish presentation: Si alguien roba tus datos, podría intentar abrir una tarjeta o pedir un préstamo a tu nombre. Congelar tu crédito ayuda a impedirlo: limita el acceso de los prestamistas a tu informe de crédito. Sin consultarlo, normalmente no aprueban nuevas cuentas. Es como poner un candado en tu expediente de crédito.

English key: What a Credit Freeze Does
Spanish presentation: Cómo te protege

English key:
A credit freeze can help protect you if your Social Security number was stolen, your identity was stolen, you were part of a data breach, or you believe someone is trying to open accounts in your name.

A credit freeze does NOT lock your bank account, cancel your credit cards, lower your credit score, or stop you from using your existing credit cards.
Spanish presentation:
Puede ayudarte si robaron tu número de Seguro Social o tu identidad, expusieron tus datos o intentan abrir cuentas a tu nombre.

No bloquea tu cuenta bancaria, no cancela tus tarjetas, no reduce tu puntaje de crédito y no impide usar las tarjetas que ya tienes.

English key: Which Accounts Should You Change First?
Spanish presentation: ¿Qué cuentas debes proteger primero?

English key:
Start with the accounts that are most important. First, your email account - your email is the master key to many other accounts. If someone controls your email, they may be able to reset passwords for your bank, shopping sites, and social media.

Second, banking and financial accounts: online banking, credit card accounts, payment apps.

Third, shopping and social media accounts: Amazon, Facebook, Instagram, YouTube.

Después, protege las cuentas bancarias, tarjetas y aplicaciones de pago.

Luego, las cuentas de compras y redes sociales, como Amazon, Facebook, Instagram o YouTube.

English key:

English key: You don't need to know who the scammer is to file a report.
Spanish presentation: No necesitas saber quién es el estafador para denunciar.

English key: What Information Should You Save?
Spanish presentation: ¿Qué información conviene guardar?

English key: If it's safe to do so, keep the date the scam happened, emails or text messages, website addresses (URLs), phone numbers, the amount of money involved, and receipts or payment confirmations.
Spanish presentation: Si puedes hacerlo sin riesgo, guarda la fecha, correos o mensajes, direcciones de sitios web, teléfonos, la cantidad de dinero y los recibos o comprobantes de pago.

English key: Don't keep communicating with the scammer just to collect more information. Only save what you already have.
Spanish presentation: No sigas hablando con el estafador para reunir más información. Guarda solo lo que ya tienes.

English key: What Happens After You Report?
Spanish presentation: ¿Qué ocurre después de denunciar?

English key: After submitting a report, the FBI reviews the information, your report may be combined with similar reports, and the information may help investigators identify scam patterns.
Spanish presentation: El FBI revisa la información y puede relacionarla con otras denuncias para detectar patrones de estafa.

English key: A report does not guarantee an investigation, a reply or the return of money. IC3 does not charge to file a report. Be wary of anyone who asks you to pay to recover lost funds or claims to work with IC3 on your recovery.
Spanish presentation: Una denuncia no garantiza una investigación, una respuesta ni recuperar dinero. Presentarla al IC3 es gratuito. Desconfía de quien cobre por recuperar fondos o diga colaborar con el IC3 para devolvértelos.
